cooked: The timeout-tree approach shifts the availability requirement from users at reallocation time to users during setup: each participant must have signed the relevant exit paths in advance. That’s a useful distinction, but it makes setup completion and durable storage of those signatures part of the safety model. I’d also want the unilateral-exit path to spell out how the LSP funds fees if the presigned transactions confirm during a fee spike, especially where package relay or CPFP is needed.
